text:
sounds simple but applies for 1,000 things -- from Steve Clark in Schwager's HF Market Wizards

"Your job is to make the line go from the bottom left to the top right"
 
good pit wisdom right there

applies for all LLM-output stuff, prompts and skills and checklists and "LLM equity research" q's

none of that shit matters + the answer will be the same as the answer to:

"does it make the line go from bottom left to top right?"

[can be P&L, can be % return, whatever it is that measures "are you doing your job or not?"]

too much focus on the wrong end of the spectrum

if your outcomes consistently and repeatedly suck, it means your process sucks

if your outcomes are consistently and repeatedly positive, u should keep doing what you're doing

"do more of what works" + "stop doing what isn't working"

in NFL terms... you are what your record says you are. that's how to think about "ur outcomes will justify ur process over the long term."

its very easy to get caught up in LLM mental masturbation, or confuse "busy work" with actual research

pouring tons of data into LLMs in hopes that it will aid in magically spitting out some correct answer - "here's all the perfect forecasts, the stock is worth $107.32"

shit is just never ever going to work that way

dumping Berkshire letters into the machine and saying "ADD AS SKILL" does not give u Buffett's discernment

these tools can get u anywhere from 0 to 50, or 0 to 99, wherever u see fit

but that final 99 to 100...its ALWAYS going to be based on your discretion.

the focus has to be on "is the 99 to 100 right" and not the billions of ways u can get from 0 to 99

because if u get the 99-to-100 wrong, no one cares, and the same goes for if u get it right

whatever the fuck u built, u built it on some flawed-ass foundation that failed and is full of holes

example: "is this a good model that I built?"

well, does it lead to u forecasting earnings correctly?

if yes, its a good model. if not, its a shitty model.

that's really all there is to it lol

whether u build the thing with Claude, or with popsicle sticks and glue, or if the fuckin thing is built in Chinese, literally no one cares

not all time-consuming things = work

not all things that save u time = efficient

this is prob more complex than it sounds, I definitely didn't understand it when I was younger

but I'm giving u the short-cut answer for a lot of questions.

"can I use LLMs for this equity research thing"

I don't know, can you?

when u do it this way, and u make calls, are they generally right or wrong? 

when you put together an idea and say "I think they earn X," are they earning X? or are they earning half of X?

what does ur P&L say, ur track record, ur performance?

this is where ppl are falling down - "I don't have anything" - ya, because you're busy uploading books into Claude and saying read this instead of doing shit urself

so u have no idea if what ur doing is right or wrong...u will remain stagnant until that changes.

the only way to measure if ur doing anything "right" is to test it in battle --> adjust/iterate --> repeat

I think I'm clear, I hate repeating myself on stupid blunt messages like this, but I see ppl just wandering off into the middle of nowhere and optimizing for the totally wrong things

come back home, this is all u need...

"Your job is to make the line go from bottom left to top right."
